add.name: EnrichmentEngine
add.description: Fetches the Google Maps place JSON for a business's source_id (share-link URL), parses name/phone/website/description/rating/review_count/photos/social, and applies fill-empty UPDATEs to businesses; sets rating_source='google'. Reuses robots.rs, rate_limiter.rs, user_agent_rotator.rs. Idempotent and rerunnable.

add.name: POST /enrich
add.description: axum route on the existing :8080 worker; accepts {business_ids?: uuid[], limit?, dry_run?}, runs EnrichmentEngine, returns a per-business report (field, previous, applied). Unauthenticated, matching /scrape (internal LAN service).

add.name: Admin enrichment trigger
add.description: Admin-only POST /api/admin/enrichment (createAuthMiddleware(['admin'])) that forwards to bw-scraper POST /enrich and displays the per-business report in the admin console.

add.name: Admin content editor
add.description: Admin-only form + PATCH /api/admin/businesses/[id]/content to manually fix website/phone/menu_url/image_url/description/social_urls per business (manual override writes regardless of fill-empty rule).
